name: Know-how
job: Your procedures, written once, answering questions and walking people through each step
intro: Each answer and procedure is a page with an owner and a check date. Your Lemma answers from them in Teams, Slack, its mailbox and web chat, saying which page and who checked it when. A question it can't answer goes to the owner, and their reply becomes the answer.
does: Every answer ends with one line: which page, and who checked it when. Past its check date, the team gets a warning and customers get nothing.
A question nobody's page answers goes to the topic's owner. Their reply comes back as a draft they save in one press, and the next person is answered.
Procedures are walked one step at a time in chat, and a question asked mid-walk becomes a proposed change to that step.

accounts.why: Your Lemma's own Teams or Slack connection: people ask where they already work, and owners are asked there. Know-how listens in the Slack channels you choose.
Reads the Drive folders you pick, so first pages are drafted from them, and reads them again each week.

setup: Once for the team: upload your handbooks, add your website or Drive folders, and the Lemma proposes topics and first pages from them.
Say who owns each topic, which ones are sensitive or for a restricted group, and whether customers may read answers.
Or look around with a sample Wednesday at a made-up lighting company: twenty pages, 48 questions, a playbook.
